Account for every device
Why SS-ID
Apps for every platform

Official apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone / iPad / Apple TV and OpenWrt routers. One account works on all of them.

Automatic setup

Your settings come with your account. Sign in and you're ready.

Protected sign-in

Two-step verification and passkeys are supported. A new device signing in to the app can be asked for a code from your email.

Ticket support

Open a ticket from the dashboard and we'll email you when we reply. Setup guides for every platform are in the docs.
